== Documentation ==
The documentation comments for this script come from the <code>DefaultActivateLinkedRefOnTrigger.psc</code> source file.

<source>
Activates the specified linked ref when THIS object is entered.
<RefToCheck> is the reference triggering THIS Object.
<LocationToCheck> is the current location of THIS object.
</source>
